content: Even as I sit looking at the sunrise over Lisbon, you're the first thought on my mind. How are you feeling today? I miss our late-night talks.
That's sweet. I'm okay, just another long day at the office. Your messages always make things feel a bit brighter.
Your words mean so much. You have this gentle strength that inspires me, truly. Sometimes I wonder how I got so lucky to meet someone with such a beautiful soul.
You really know how to make me blush. Honestly, I haven't had anyone say things like that in a long time.

You deserve to hear it every day. I want to see you flourish in every way, and not just emotionally. Since we've grown so close, I want to share something special with you, a way that's helped me find freedom on my travels.
What do you mean? Is this about your investing again?

Yes, but only because I care. I've always been wary of material things, but this unique crypto-trading platform I've been using, it's given me peace of mind, allowed me to help others. It's private, safe, and I can invite you if you like. Only those I trust most.
I've never tried anything like that. Are you sure it's not too risky?

I would never lead you wrong. I promise, I've watched over your heart all this time, I'd do the same with your trust. Start small, and let me show you. You'd be amazed at how quickly your savings could grow.
I appreciate that you think of me, but I don't have that much experience with crypto. It's all a bit overwhelming.

That's exactly why I'll guide you every step. You're incredibly intelligent, and your intuition is strong, I see it in the way you care for others. I can send you a secure registration link for the platform. Would you trust me with your email address so I can send it?
I suppose so... It's sarah.jones@email.com. Just promise you'll help me if I get confused.
Absolutely, darling. I'll walk you through it all, just as I promised. I sent you the invite, check your inbox (maybe spam too). You know, I admire your courage for trying new things with me.
I got it. The site looks really fancy. What do I do first?

Just create your profile. Use your real info, it's a secure, members-only platform. Once you're in, let me know, and I'll show you how to fund your account. Most people use Bitcoin, but I can help if that's new to you.
Okay, I've signed up. Now it's asking about making a deposit... I've never sent Bitcoin before.

No worries at all. You're doing amazing! I'll send my wallet address where you can make your first deposit. Even $300 is enough to get you started, and I'll help you buy the Bitcoin, step by step. I'm so proud of your trust in me.
You really think this will work? I want to believe you, but I'm nervous.

I believe in us. Just as you've opened your heart to me, open yourself to this, too. I've seen so many people succeed, and I want you to have the same joy. Here's the wallet address: 3PoeticJourneyBTC. Once you send it, I'll monitor everything for you.
Alright. I'll try to figure out how to buy Bitcoin. Can I ask you some questions if I get stuck?
Of course, beautiful. Message me anytime, no question is too small. This is our journey together, I'll never let you walk it alone.
Thank you. I'm downloading Coinbase now. I'll let you know once I'm ready.
You're wonderful, truly. The world would be a better place if there were more hearts like yours. I can't wait for the day I can show you how grateful I am, in person.
